stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class; 91% admitted per College Navigator): the latest Cleveland State Common Data Set on its site is 2021-2022, so no Common Data Set was used. Enrolled is full- plus part-time first-time students (1,550 full-time). International applicant counts, GPA and test-score percentiles are not included in these figures: College Navigator lists SAT/ACT as 'not considered' and shows no score table. Navigator shows U.S. nonresidents at about 6% of undergraduates (rounded), so the number of international undergraduates is not shown. Undergraduate enrollment 9,482 is fall 2024.

cost.notes: College Navigator estimated expenses for full-time beginning undergraduates, 2024-25 (tuition and fees; on-campus food and housing)
